verdict.rationale: Archived docs describe a REST interface for connecting to MCP servers, a CLI, and SDKs, but none show that the API matches everything the UI can do. A first-party notice says the Smithery API, CLI, SDKs, accounts and API keys were shut down on October 31, 2026, leaving only a public registry with no documented API surface. Probes for an OpenAPI spec also returned 404, so there is no evidence of API/UI parity today.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
